title: Membership in the reachable set
statement: Let $K,L,t$ be natural numbers, let $R$ be a binary relation on the natural numbers, and let $I$ be a predicate on the natural numbers. Define a walk of length at most $L$ from $u$ to $t$ to allow stopping at the current vertex or taking a step along $R$, with each vertex reached by a step required to be less than $K$. Then $t$ belongs to the set of vertices reachable in at most $L$ steps from some $I$-vertex $u<K$ if and only if such a starting vertex and walk exist.
hypotheses_covered: $R$ is a binary relation on the natural numbers
$I$ is a predicate on the natural numbers
